We were using Sprinto for compliance automation for a year or so. In our recent renewal we ran into a payment issue; someone from their finance team disabled our account as due date had passed. It took ~48h to resolve, and now they say termination for convenience isn't allowed and threaten legal action if we don't pay ~$4000 for the full year.
We also believe that their regular employees have extended access into customer data which honestly makes us uncomfortable to operate with them.
